messages:
deploybot: Scheduled release v2.14.0 to production at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z. Canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Change window: 22:00-02:00 UTC. Rolling across regions.

alice: Heads up — seeing alert spike from k8s autoscaler in eu-west-1 tied to redis failover, incident #INC-2026-034 in #incidents.

bob: holding any outgoing deploys until incident triage gives the all-clear. tagging @ops-lead.

carla: +1 hold. If we need to unblock, we can fallback to pinned image `rdw/runtime:2026-02-05` and route traffic to us-east-1.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-034 severity=sev2, status=investigating, assigned=@dinesh.

dinesh: investigating now. looks like redis failover caused a transient kvcache eviction storm. not ready to clear for deploys.

emma: ok — can we pin the release to avoid the new kv-cache patch? release notes need update either way.

bob: proposal: pause rollout, set `release_state=held`, pin nodes to `rdw/runtime:2026-02-05` for next 6h, reschedule full rollout to 2026-03-21 01:00 UTC (post-mitigation). ops, ok?

ops-lead: agree with pause + pin. require canary re-run in us-east-1 only, then staggered zone roll (us-east -> us-west -> eu-west). also want an A/B fallback flag for 30m after canary.

carla: to confirm commands:
```
# pause rollout
deployctl release pause v2.14.0 --reason "INC-2026-034"
# pin image
deployctl rollout set-image v2.14.0 rdw/runtime:2026-02-05 --scope clusters
# requeue
deployctl schedule v2.14.0 --start 2026-03-21T01:00:00Z --stagger 30m
```

alice: logging this in the release notes draft, adding a note about kv-cache patch deferred.

deploybot: Confirmed: release v2.14.0 is now HELD (tag: INC-2026-034). Canary cancelled. Requeue scheduled for 2026-03-21T01:00:00Z. Requeue-ID=RQ-2460032100-1.

dinesh: quick follow-up — if redis cluster is flaky, prefer to keep canary small (5%) and enable `fallback_to_readonly=true` for clients. prevents write storms.

ops-lead: good call. add `fallback_to_readonly` as a canary gate and set automatic rollback to previous pinned image on any error > 5% 5xx within 15m.

emma: I'll update release notes with the hold reason, rollback criteria, and the new change window. will ping on release doc when done. :white_check_mark:

bob: thanks everyone. once incident clears, we'll re-run the automated preflight and then proceed with the staggered rollout per ops plan.

carla: for tracking — created PR #3421 that updates release metadata and rollback policy. linking in INC-2026-034.

deploybot: Final status: HELD -> RQ-2460032100-1. Notifications sent to oncall rotation and PG owners.

alice: closing thread here, continue incident updates in #incidents. will reopen if deploy needs immediate attention. :thumbsup:
